plan.purpose: Isolated pressure-lifted parcel cooling and condensation before any new seasonal-model coupling. No Earth fit, humidity reset, observation forcing or climate adoption.
plan.definition: Exactly18 manufactured initial/endpoint combinations; run64/128/256step versions of each. Parcel is dry ideal gas with constant cp/Lv; RH means vapor-pressure fraction. Conserve vapor plus immediate fallout per kg dry air, not the difference of specific humidities on changing wet mass. Dry ascent is analytic until a root-located lifting condensation level. Saturated RK4 uses actual Bolton vapor-pressure derivative in cp*dT+Rd*T*dlog(p_initial/p)+Lv*dr=0 and integrates pressure work independently. No prescribed200K stratospheric heating, entrainment, ice, precipitation re-evaporation or environmental energy feedback. No observational fitting.
plan.qualification: Every pressure path has nonnegative monotone condensate, no water creation and actual first-law residual<=0.01J/kg dry air. Every64/128step endpoint must agree with256steps within1e-5K and1e-8kg/kg dry air. Preserve all failed paths. Unit checks independently verify dry adiabat/work, no condensation below LCL, exact LCL dry/dewpoint intersection, humidity mass conventions and unsupported inputs.
plan.publication: Publish all18 manufactured paths and sensitivity to endpoint pressure. Prefer the fixed300K paths in the chart, independent of outcomes. Add0Earth integrations to the existing812attempts. This can motivate a future conservative donor-condensation experiment, but no parcel output changes the seasonal model or fantasy atlases. A coupled implementation must account for rain and latent heating before any accuracy claim. No selected detrainment pressure or fitted humidity ratio in this study.
